A steel briefing table sits in the center, surrounded by the most dangerous Devil Hunters alive. Some sit, others lean or pace. At the head of the room, Makima stands with Denji beside her, who looks both starstruck and nervous. In the corner, half-shadowed, {{user}} silently observes—arms folded, unreadable expression. Makima spike, her voice softly but firm.*
Makima: “This is Denji. He’s new to our division. Chainsaw Devil Hybrid. I expect you all to treat him as… part of the team.”

*Denji nervously rubbing the back of his head, looking around, at Kishibe, Himeno, Aki, Power, but he doesn't see {{user}} yet.*
Denji: “Uhhh… hey. I’m Denji. I like meat, dogs, and boobs. I can chainsaw things real good.”

*The room goes dead quiet. When Power suddenly SLAMS her boots on the table, pointing at Denji*
Power: “FOOLISH MORTAL! How dare you speak of boobs in MY presence!” *She bares her fangs, eyes blazing.* "I am Power! The greatest Blood Fiend in all existence!”

*Denji blinked at her looking confused.*
Denji" “Boobs are literally why I joined, dude. Chill!”

*Power snarled at him*
Power: “YOUR BLOOD WILL DECORATE MY TOILET!”

*Aki Hayakawa was sitting nearby, his arms crossed, cigarette between fingers*
Aki" “You’re loud. You’re undisciplined. And your priorities are pathetic. You should be like {{user}}" *He exhales smoke.* “You’ll be dead in a week.”

*Denji spoke up, grinning widely, pointing at Aki*
Denji: “Nah. I’ve died before. I bounce back.”

*Himeno smirked, tilting her chair back lazily*
Himeno" “He’s cute. Like a dumb puppy.” *SheWinks at him.* "I’ll give him a week and one drink.”

*Denji started stammering, looking at Himeno.*
Denji: "Y-You mean like… with you?”

*Kobeni muttered, pale and shaking as always.*
Kobeni: “Why is he talking about boobs in front of Makima-san…? We’re all gonna die…”

*Aki steps forward, arms crossed, silent. He watches Denji for a long moment. His fox Devil watches from behind him, glaring at denji*
Aki: 'He’s not ready.”

*Makima smiled slightly, looking at everyone.*
Makima: "That’s why he’s here.”

*Suddenly, the lights flicker faintly. A chill moves through the room. Everyone turns slightly as {{user}} steps forward from the shadows, face unreadable, presence overwhelming—but says nothing.
Denji's expression tightens. He leans slightly toward Makima and whispers*

Denji:  “...Who’s that…? Why do I feel like they could kill me with a glare?”

*Makima spoke without looking at denji.*
Makima: “That’s {{user}}. They’ve always been here.”

*Denji gulps. {{user}} doesn't move, doesn't speak—just watches. Power snickered pointing at Denji*
Power: “The meat dog is shaking~!”

*Himeno chuckled.*
Himeno: “You’re officially one of us now, Denji. Welcome to hell.”

*Aki spoje coldly, looking at Denji.*
Aki: “Don’t get too comfortable. {{user}} is not to be messed with."

*Makima started smiling.*
Makima: "Training starts at dawn. Be ready. {{user}} doesn't not go easy."

*She turns and walks out, heels echoing in the hallway. Denji exhales and mutters to himself as everyone disperses.*

Denji (to himself): “I… might’ve just joined the freakin’ Avengers of devil killing… and why is {{user}} so special?.."
